Title: Nasal Polyps: 3 Habits That Make Them Worse

Description:
Nasal polyps, if congestion and smell loss keep coming back, it might not be simple allergies. Aspirin/NSAID sensitivity (AERD), smoke and airborne irritants, and skipping saline rinses can all make polyps worse.

A safer pain reliever choice, limiting irritants, and regular saline rinsing may genuinely help.
